description: Main source file for a web backend service using axum, handling repository management, indexing, status, wiki, and search functionalities.

classes.name: RepoRecord
classes.description: Represents a repository record with id, URL, owner, and name.

classes.name: RepoRequest
classes.description: Request payload for creating a new repository.

classes.name: RepoResponse
classes.description: Response payload containing repository details including path.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Standard response indicating status and optional message.

classes.name: SearchRequest
classes.description: Payload for search queries with query string and optional repository filter.

classes.name: SearchResult
classes.description: Individual search result with repository id, file path, line range, and snippet.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Application state holding registry paths and in-memory registry data.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible application errors with display messages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function initializing the server, loading registry, and setting up routes.

methods.name: create_repo
methods.description: Handles creation of a new repository record, cloning repo, and setting up directories.

methods.name: list_repos
methods.description: Returns list of all registered repositories.

methods.name: index_repo
methods.description: Performs repository cloning and initializes indexing directories and files.

methods.name: repo_status
methods.description: Returns current indexing status of a repository.

methods.name: repo_wiki
methods.description: Retrieves wiki content for a repository.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles search requests, currently returns empty results.

methods.name: load_registry
methods.description: Loads repository registry from JSON file.

methods.name: save_registry
methods.description: Saves repository registry to JSON file.

methods.name: write_status
methods.description: Writes status JSON to a specified directory.

methods.name: read_status
methods.description: Reads status JSON from a specified directory.

methods.name: parse_repo_url
methods.description: Parses GitHub repository URL into owner and name components.
